title: Product
description: Gold entity: Product. Materialized from Oracle EBS Inventory (MTL_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B joined to EGO_MTL_SY_ITEMS_EXT_B for ISBN attrs). 1 row per (inventory_item_id, org_id). x-channels declares which downstream tier(s) consume each attribute: event ⊂ message ⊂ api.

inventory_item_id.description: EBS internal surrogate. Maps to MTL_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B.INVENTORY_ITEM_ID. Part of the natural key.

product_id.description: Human-readable item number. Maps to MTL_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B.SEGMENT1.

org_id.description: Organization identifier. Maps to MTL_SYSTEM_ITEMS_B.ORGANIZATION_ID. Part of the natural key.

isbn10.description: ISBN-10. Maps to EGO_MTL_SY_ITEMS_EXT_B.C_EXT_ATTR6 where ATTR_GROUP_ID = 741.

isbn13.description: ISBN-13. Maps to EGO_MTL_SY_ITEMS_EXT_B.C_EXT_ATTR8 where ATTR_GROUP_ID = 741.
